newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Diablo Canyon 1 nuke seen fully back Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Diablo Canyon 1 nuke seen fully back Sunday.

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co (PG&E) said Friday its 1,087 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon 1 nuclear generating station was expected to resume full operation Sunday, a couple of days later than first estimated.
"It is expected to return to full power Sunday," PG&E said following electrical repairs.
The Avila Beach, Calif., unit tripped off line a week ago following a fire in an auxiliary power grounding transformer.
Neighboring Diablo Canyon unit 2, rated at 1,073 MW, was producing at 100 percent capacity, PG&E said.
